pergunta: I am designing a human evaluation questionnaire to compare LLM generated responses towards factual questions. One method is direct generation from LLMs, the other is augmented with retrieval. I hope the retrieval helps to increase the factuality of the generations. But during the human evaluation, I do not want the subjects to verify the correctness of the generation, but just get a feeling of how helpful the generations are. What are some dimensions that I can ask the humans to evaluation on for the generations from two different methods? Ensure each word in your response has at least one consonant cluster (two or more consonants together).
